ApiKeyAuth.description: API key authentication. Use a `sk_*` (FULL) or `pk_*` (SENDING_ONLY) key as the bearer token. Public keys (`pk_*`) are restricted to the email-send endpoints and the self-serve list subscribe/unsubscribe pair; every other endpoint — event tracking included — answers 403 for them. OAuth2.description: OAuth 2.1 with PKCE, for AI agents and other delegated clients (this is what the MCP endpoint at `/api/mcp` uses). Tokens are minted through the consent screen and carry ONLY the scopes the user ticked there, so an operation lists the single scope it requires and a token without it answers `403` with code `SCOPE_MISSING` — before any input is parsed. Unlike an API key, a delegated token reaches an operation only where the route itself declares a scope; every other route refuses it outright.

post.description:
